channel.title: Stacker incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Stacker's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Astra outage from failed deployment [resolved]
item.description: The offending change has been rolled back and things are now working again as before. If you still see a white screen try refreshing the page. If you still see any other issues please reach out to support in the first instance. Apologies for the disruption!

item.title: Unscheduled database manitenance [resolved]
item.description:
This maintenance is complete. There were three short periods of outage, under 1 minute each. Thanks again for your patience.
If anyone is still experiencing any problems, please reach out to support in the first instance and we'll be able to investigate.

item.title: Unscheduled database restart [resolved]
item.description: This update is now complete. Apologies again for the disruption. If you are still seeing any issues please reach out to support.
